name: Landscape Connections
summary: A GBP 150 million initiative for about 20 long-term nature-recovery projects in UK Protected Landscapes, led by not-for-profits or partnerships they lead, with grants up to GBP 10 million.
reporting: Grantees must measure the project's impact on nature recovery and on engaging people, using government outcomes frameworks where they exist.

status.quote: You can apply for a grant up to £10m through our National Lottery Heritage Grants £250,000 to £10m.

applicant_types.quote: Applications are open to not-for-profit organisations, and partnerships led by not-for-profit organisations, from across the UK.

geography.quote: Applications are open to not-for-profit organisations, and partnerships led by not-for-profit organisations, from across the UK.

access.quote: For grants over £250,000 you must first submit an Expression of Interest.

amount.quote: You can apply for a grant up to £10m through our National Lottery Heritage Grants £250,000 to £10m.

reporting.quote: Allocate resources to measuring the impact of your project for both nature recovery and engaging people
